about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Fostering innovation, collaboration, and practical learning to empower the next generation of builders.
about.heading: Who We Are
paragraphs: We're more than just a tech community. We're a movement dedicated to empowering the next generation of innovators, fostering collaboration, and building technologies that make a difference.
Tech4Hack is a global tech community dedicated to fostering innovation, collaboration, and practical learning.
We believe the best way to learn technology is by building, experimenting, and solving real-world problems together.
about.mission: To create an inclusive environment where aspiring developers, seasoned professionals, and curious minds can come together to learn, build, and create meaningful impact through technology.
about.vision: To create one of the world's most vibrant communities of innovators, creators, and future technology leaders.

chapterProcess.title: Chapter Setup Process
chapterProcess.subtitle: From Ideation to Impact — A Step-by-Step Journey
chapterProcess.description: Empowering passionate student leaders across India to launch, nurture, and lead thriving Tech4Hack chapters in their colleges.

steps.title: Obtain College Permission
items: Get approval from the Head of Department (HOD) and Dean.
Seek support from the college, if required.

steps.title: Create an Official College Email ID
items: Set up an official college email ID (e.g., tech4hack@college.ac.in).
Use it for all official communications.

steps.title: Organise Your First Event
items: Start with a technical workshop or speaker session.
Build your community and engage students.

steps.title: Plan Bigger Initiatives
items: Build on the success of your first event.
Organise hackathons, workshops, and other technical events.
